UiOrb.description: A 3D WebGL (Three.js) AI Agent visualizer with distinct states.

agentState.description: The current operational state of the agent which drives the animation.

inputVolume.description: The volume of the user's voice (RMS 0.0 to 1.0) driving the orb's spikes.

outputVolume.description: The volume of the agent's voice (RMS 0.0 to 1.0) driving the orb's pulsing.

colors.description: A tuple of two CSS color strings (e.g. ['#ff0000', '#0000ff']) used for the orb gradient.

seed.description: A random seed for procedural noise generation.

UiAudioPlayer.description: A compound audio player pill featuring play/pause controls, scrubbing, and time displays.

src.description: The URL of the audio file to play.

DemoPodcastPlayer.description: A rich, full-card podcast player combining the UiOrb, scrolling waveforms, and audio controls.

UiPlaylist.description: A queue list for audio tracks. Requires an ancestor UiAudioProvider to function fully.

emptyText.description: The text to display when there are no items.

DemoAgentCard.description: A 3D flipping card that shows an Agent's capabilities and its underlying A2A JSON manifest.

name.description: The display name of the Agent.

capabilities.description: A list of strings defining what the agent can do.
